publicationTitle: 2020 Congreso Internacional de Innovación y Tendencias en Ingeniería (CONIITI)
abstract: Part of the soils of the southern regions of Peru are composed of volcanic ashes, deposited and located in the mountainous depressions near the area of volcanic influence, the configuration of the stratum being variable, depending on the distance of the origin. These soils have mechanical characteristics that are not suitable for the execution of civil projects, low cohesion, maximum dry density less than or equal to 1g/cm<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">3</sup>, differential settlements and high susceptibility to erosion due to rain and wind, these are characteristic of these soils. The present investigation proposes an exploratory study of the mechanical properties modified with the application of calcium oxide, in proportions of 4%, 6% and 8% with 3 days and 7 days of curing.The results showed that there is an increase in the cohesion value and friction angle according to the amount of lime used and the curing time.

articleTitle: Evaluation of the Mechanical Behavior Compressive of Concrete Walls Lightened with Expanded Polyestyerene
publicationTitle: 2020 Congreso Internacional de Innovación y Tendencias en Ingeniería (CONIITI)
abstract: The present research is about the evaluation of mechanical simple compressive of alternative construction system of concrete reinforced walls with expanded polystyrene, in low slenderness wall, using two kind of revetment: mortar with f'<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">cre</sub> = 14 MPa; and concrete with f'c = 17.5 MPa. Both types of walls are reinforced with reinforcement mesh and constructive reinforcement ratio. This report is focused to the Colombian context since this wall system is using often in family home construction and it seeks to break through traditional constructive systems. The analysis does not pretend to detract the general advantage at system, rather it aims to study detailed aspects of mechanical behavior based in its structural potential, lightness satisfactory and suitable stress.

articleTitle: A Hyperledger Model for the Deployment of Smart Contracts in a Public Organization in Ecuador
publicationTitle: 2020 Congreso Internacional de Innovación y Tendencias en Ingeniería (CONIITI)
abstract: Were analyzed the deployment of a Smart Contract in a Public Organization in Ecuador, also were analyzed a current problem in the Ecuadoŕs Public Sector, like is the inefficient handling of resources. The objective of this research is to define a model Hyperledger based Blockchain solution. For this research the method selected to this analysis was the method deductive. As results we have a simplified model Hyperledger of the implementation of a Smart Contract, A mathematical model to prove the efficiency of the using Smart Contracts in the processes of hiring in the organizations publics and a Prototype of a generic algorithm for the deployment of a Smart Contract by means of based Blockchain solution. After the analysis it was concluded that the implementation of Smart Contracts both in the Ecuadorians sector public and in any other is a benefit to the organizations.

articleTitle: Geoelectric Model for the Analysis of the Relation Amongst Hydraulic and Electrical Conductivity in the Soil
publicationTitle: 2020 Congreso Internacional de Innovación y Tendencias en Ingeniería (CONIITI)
abstract: In this research, a hydrogeological model was generated for the analysis of the hydraulic conductivity by means of an indirect geoelectric exploration, through Vertical Electric soundings and direct geotechnical exploration, with the recovery of altered and unaltered down-to-six-meter samples. At the laboratory, samples from the two perforations were characterized and the value of the hydraulic conductivity K (m / d) was determined from a sample from each site by using the Hyprop 2 equipment. The Verifications of the measurement values within the reference ranges were used to generate 2D and 3D models from the thickness and layers from the subsoil. Afterwards, by using the referenced author's proposed methodologies, the hydraulic conductivity (K m / d) was determined through the correlations amongst the values of formation factor (F) and fines content of fines (C).

articleTitle: Implementation of Industry 4.0 Technologies in Embedded Systems for Contagion Mitigation and COVID-19 Control in Work Areas
publicationTitle: 2020 Congreso Internacional de Innovación y Tendencias en Ingeniería (CONIITI)
abstract: The aim of this study is focused on implementation and integration of Industry 4.0 technologies such as Radio Frequency Identification (RFID), Internet of things (IoT), Cloud computing, and Artificial Intelligence (AI) implemented in low cost embedded systems to reduce the risk of epidemiological contagion in work areas related to SARS CoV2 . The present work integrates hardware , software and telecommunications tools to reduce of the risk of contagion by contact of common surfaces, the control of physical distancing, and traceability of human contacts for the realization of effective epidemiological fences, allowing companies to reactivate tasks safely through his implementation.

articleTitle: Scientific discussion of selected viruses including COVID-19 in hot springs
publicationTitle: 2020 Congreso Internacional de Innovación y Tendencias en Ingeniería (CONIITI)
abstract: The objective of this study is to discuss selected viruses including COVID-19 and their potential elimination processes in hot springs. Studies in Colombia are limited and this scientific discussion provides necessary information regarding these viruses. This includes studies both in Colombia and international levels on the following subjects: i) the presence of viruses in hot springs, ii) the non- oxidative water treatment in hot springs, iii) the elimination strategies of viruses; and iv) the influence of COVID-19 in hot springs. The results of this discussion indicate that in order for thermal waters to guarantee the elimination of the viruses originating from faecal and non-faecal derived, and the COVID-19 virus, a monitoring scheme is required to identify an effective disinfection of waters to control these pathogens.

articleTitle: Estimation of a global self-purification capacity index for Mountain Rivers from water quality data and hydrotopographic characteristics
publicationTitle: 2020 Congreso Internacional de Innovación y Tendencias en Ingeniería (CONIITI)
abstract: A global self-purification index has been formulated for Mountain Rivers that allows comparatively to quantify the assimilation capacity of pollutants discharged on water bodies. The index takes into account the processes depending on the hydrotopographic characteristics such as velocity, flow and length of the study section as well as the available water quality information, the water quality objectives and the reactive-diffusive processes that each suffer of the parameters included. A compilation of quality modeling studies and monitoring campaigns of 10 key parameters was carried out, whose information was organized in the Information System of the Self-Depuration Capacity in rivers (SINCAP for its acronym in Spanish), which is the basis for representing the maps of self-purification. The index developed was applied to a case study at the basin level for the Sumapaz River (Colombia) with secondary information available at the Regional Autonomous Corporation of Cundinamarca (CAR). The results obtained show the importance of the hydrotopographic parameters in the capacity of assimilation of a river since its relation with the aeration and sedimentation processes could be evidenced by its torrential regime, thus having the greatest reduction in the parameters of sedimentable solids and oxygen dissolved. In the same way, in tributary sections of the upper Rio basin, high values of the Global Self-Purification Index (IGAP for its acronym in Spanish) were presented, otherwise in the lower basin where the topography is flat, thus leading to lower values of assimilation capacity.

articleTitle: Influence of the Microstructure of Ceramic Materials on its Thermal Expansion an Mechanical Properties: A review
publicationTitle: 2020 Congreso Internacional de Innovación y Tendencias en Ingeniería (CONIITI)
abstract: Ceramic materials are widely studied due to their high productivity and efficiency. This work was developed by means of a descriptive type methodology where it was investigated the influence of the microstructure of ceramic materials in their thermal expansion and their mechanical properties. The objective is focused on exposing the main methods of computational simulation and the efficiency in their thermal and mechanical properties, when materials are pragmatically submitted to alloys with different elements. The papers reviewed were produced in the last decade. Finally, emphasis was placed on the possible fields in which exploration is recommended.

articleTitle: Innovation systems supported in technology transfer processes
publicationTitle: 2020 Congreso Internacional de Innovación y Tendencias en Ingeniería (CONIITI)
abstract: This document presents the results of a research process on the state of the art of innovation systems, technology transfer, and intermediation, which take place in the development of activities aimed at seeking innovation options in the different productive sectors, through articulation between the different actors of the university, the industry, and the state. In this sense, and making use of Scopus, Web of Science, and Google Scholar databases, a set of documents was obtained through which it was possible to identify: concepts on innovation systems, aspects that intervene in the transfer processes of technology that is especially related to the articulation of actors of the quadruple helix, as well as how these issues are adopted from the Colombian norms in the agro-industrial sector.

articleTitle: An Approach to Cybersecurity, Cyberbullying in Social Networks and Information Security in Public Organizations during a Pandemic: Study case COVID-19 Ecuador
publicationTitle: 2020 Congreso Internacional de Innovación y Tendencias en Ingeniería (CONIITI)
abstract: The problems of cybersecurity, cyberbullying in social networks worldwide are persistent and increasingly evident and prejudicial to society regardless of age or sex; during the COVID-19 pandemic, the Ecuador study case can show negative and psychological impacts; another of the radical problems is the information security of public organizations for strategic decision making in natural or anthropogenic disasters in Ecuador, has caused serious problems to generate public policies with effectiveness and efficiency in health, education, basic services among others. The objective of the study is to identify cybersecurity problems, cyberbullying in social networks and present alternatives to improve information security in public organizations during a pandemic. It was used deductive method and exploratory research were to analyze the information. Turned out the early evaluation in the identification of cyberattack, cyberbullying and positive, negative and psychological impacts of the use of social networks during the pandemic and a prototype of a National System of Public Data Registration based on Blockchain to improve management of risks against natural or anthropogenic disasters in Ecuador. It was concluded that for making decisions effectively, efficiently at the strategic level during a pandemic such as COVID-19 or any other natural disaster, the most important thing in the first instance is to have information with integrity, to carry out adequate planning according to the reality of each country.

articleTitle: Strategic innovation in the last decade: Review and bibliometric analysis
publicationTitle: 2020 Congreso Internacional de Innovación y Tendencias en Ingeniería (CONIITI)
abstract: During the last decade, the industry has evolved in order to adapt itself to the new demands for products and services using innovation as a tool for positioning in the global market; In this context, scientific literature has been published on strategic innovation and its applications in companies. This article presents a bibliometric analysis based on the literature indexed in the Scopus database, related to the topic of strategic innovation during the 2011-2020 period. The study is based on the analysis of bibliometric indicators produced on 369 documents. There are presented the main countries, institutions, authors, and related topics, furthermore, the analysis of areas and fields used by Scopus for research. The results provide the investigation trends and the route for the development of future research on the subject.

articleTitle: A Review on Biometric Devices to be Applied in ASD Interventions
publicationTitle: 2020 Congreso Internacional de Innovación y Tendencias en Ingeniería (CONIITI)
abstract: Currently on the market it is possible to find different biometric measurement devices with different technical specifications, costs, usability, among others. However, there is difficulty to select the most appropriate biometric device for investigations and/or interventions in therapies developed for children who have been diagnosed with Autism Spectrum Disorder (ASD). Then, a review on some biometric devices is presented, as well as some applications of this technology in different fields. Also, the information obtained from the systematic review on some of the main devices currently available on the market for the selected technologies (Eye tracking and Electroencephalography-EEG) is related, as well as the considerations on operation, licensing, costs, physical and technical specifications, among other relevant aspects for the selection of the device are presented. Its technical specifications are also detailed, allowing it to be considered according to these specifications and their cost in the market, which could be the most appropriate devices depending on the type of the use that can be applied within the research and/or intervention in the therapeutic sessions of children with ASD.

articleTitle: Evaluation of the Management of the Scope, Schedule and Cost in the Stage of Studies and Designs of Road Mesh Works, for a Consulting Contract in the City of Bogotá
publicationTitle: 2020 Congreso Internacional de Innovación y Tendencias en Ingeniería (CONIITI)
abstract: This document presents the review, evaluation and analysis of the scope, schedule and cost management from the point of view of the Project Management for a consulting contract whose purpose is to carry out the studies and designs of road network works in a town of the city of Bogotá; focusing on the evaluation of the scope, schedule and cost management, as established in the Guide to the Fundamentals for Project Management from its group of planning processes; in order to make a comparison with the traditional methodology used by the consulting company; and through a comparison with the "should be" of the project management; in order to establish the respective recommendations to manage a project and thus reduce the amount of changes for this type of contract.

articleTitle: Bayes network model to prevent hypertension
publicationTitle: 2020 Congreso Internacional de Innovación y Tendencias en Ingeniería (CONIITI)
abstract: Heart diseases have been on the rise worldwide, due to the fast pace of life that promotes inappropriate eating habits, stress, alcohol and smoking, among others, but also due to other risk factors that are not controllable as medical family history. All of these are long-term triggers for conditions like hypertension. This is one of the leading causes of strokes, heart attacks and heart abnormalities worldwide. In Colombia, cases of death due to hypertension have been increasing in recent years, making it necessary to implement mechanisms that allow early prevention of this condition. In this article, a technological tool is presented that captures, processes and visualizes the main risk factors, calculating the probability that a person has to suffer from hypertension. This calculation is done using a Bayes network.

articleTitle: Autonomous virtual vehicles with FNN-GA and Q-learning in a video game environment
publicationTitle: 2020 Congreso Internacional de Innovación y Tendencias en Ingeniería (CONIITI)
abstract: Driving autonomous virtual vehicles have been developed by the use of several artificial intelligence (AI) algorithms. However, it is possible to improve their results and find other applications through the use of new algorithms or combinations of them. Taking into account this, in this work, firstly Feed-forward Neural Network (FNN) and Genetic Algorithm (GA) were selected, and then, these algorithms were combined to have the new FNN-GA algorithm. In order to evaluate its performance, the most popular circuits, such as ovals and tracks with different types of curves, were selected from auto racing, which were implemented in the Unity 2D video game engine. After, as a way to compare the performance of the "FNN-GA" algorithm, the Q-learning algorithm was selected, and the agents to learn with them were placed on said tracks. As a result, after executing 100 generations of the agents, per algorithm, it is found that taking into account the better use of CPU and RAM resources, Q-learning is the best, on the contrary, taking into account the quantity of in learning generations, FNN-GA is the best since it learns in fewer generations. On the other hand, both algorithms learn easier on ovals than on circuits with different types of curves.

articleTitle: Viability of the use of infrared thermography in the assessment of heat stress in industrial welders
publicationTitle: 2020 Congreso Internacional de Innovación y Tendencias en Ingeniería (CONIITI)
abstract: The aim of this article is to determine the feasibility of the use of infrared thermography in the diagnosis of heat stress in industrial welders. It is a non-experimental, transverse, correlational study. Data were collected from 12 welders (men) from the Colombian metalworking and construction sector. Their internal body temperature was measured with a personal thermal stress monitor (tympanic temperature, °C) and 456 thermographic records(external temperature,°C) of 6 quadrants of the back were made, and the maximum temperature in each of the quadrants was determined. The Pearson statistical test was applied to determine the correlation between the values of the internal temperature and the maximum temperatures in each of the quadrants of the thermogram. A linear regression was also applied to establish a prediction model of the internal temperature from the temperatures of the quadrants of the back. The resulting thermograms of quadrant 3 would predict the internal temperature of the welder monitored in 51% of cases. In conclusion, it was found out that infrared thermography is an effective method for the prediction of thermal stress by heat in welders and is valid for the evaluation of occupational exposure.

articleTitle: Hazard map based on the simulation of sludge flow in a two-dimensional model, Case Quebrada Malanche-Punta Hermosa -Lima-Perú
publicationTitle: 2020 Congreso Internacional de Innovación y Tendencias en Ingeniería (CONIITI)
abstract: This research presents the numerical simulation to reproduce the transport and deposition processes of the sludge flow on March 15, 2017, strongly impacting the town of Pampapacta in Punta Hermosa-Peru. The debris flow initiation process in the basin was represented by hydrographs obtained from the estimated volumes of stormwater runoff and solid materials. The sludge flow was modeled in Flo2D to calculate hazard maps with the discharge event and others with different return periods. The numerical simulation results show acceptable results in relation to what happened. The model used to assess the hazard due to debris flow can predict and delineate, with acceptable precision, potentially hazardous areas for a landslide. The application of the proposed methodology to assess the hazard of disasters due to debris flows in basins and streams is useful to understand the extent of the impact of the mud flow during extreme weather events, as well as to develop emergency plans and formulate disaster policies.

articleTitle: Organizational Climate Theoretical Model and its Relationship with the Occupational Safety and Health Management
publicationTitle: 2020 Congreso Internacional de Innovación y Tendencias en Ingeniería (CONIITI)
abstract: This article provides the relationship theoretical model between Occupational Health and Safety Management (OHSM) and organizational climate in order to develop the reference framework for the construct's evaluation mentioned in the organizational environment. The above was carried out based on a study process that gave rise to the relationship model between the variables. The process consisted of three stages: bibliographic retrieval, model coding, and model formulation. Stage one yielded 66 documents (hermeneutic unit - HU) associated with definition, conceptualization, constructs relationship and associated models. The next stage corresponds to the coding that was carried out through the ATLAS.ti qualitative analysis software. The coding associated with the analysis HU was open, axial and selective. The model consists of 10 dimensions that describe the individual and joint evaluation of the constructs. The results are the constructs conceptualization and definition, the theoretical relationship and finally the theoretical relationship model. It is concluded that the organizational climate dimensions related to the OHSM are: reward / salary, risk, standards, communication and participation, performance and improvement objectives, security, integration, organizational orientation, resources availability and personal development.
